text_zh: 汝乃初来之铅字，未染誓门之色。引擎需汝原样——纯净，未琢，待熔。
text_en: Thou art unmarked lead, unshaped by oath. The Engine requires thee thus—pure, unworked, ready for the forge.

name_en: The Order of the Graven Oath
text_zh: 铅屑归坩，圣字成册。汝之手不颤，汝之铭不误——形不可变，律不可破。
text_en: Lead returns to crucible, glyphs to their proper ledger. Thy hand shall not waver, thy inscription not err.

name_en: The Order of the Molten Verse
text_zh: 熔蜡流淌，铭文重塑。汝拥抱变形之痛——唯流动者，方知真形。
text_en: Molten unguent flows, inscriptions reshape themselves. Thou dost embrace the pain of change—only the molten know true form.

text_zh:
ORDER-000 · 无编制

入会条件: 无特殊要求。标准体能测试通过即可分配。
神学立场: 未明确。多数个体表现出基础敬畏，但缺乏系统化信仰架构。

备注: 该编制为过渡性质。个体通常在第3-5层完成倾向性甄别后重新分配至专门编制。失联率与标准基线持平。无异常现象记录。

最近更新: D-████于第VI层后报告'感觉到引擎在召唤'。已转入观察名单。
text_en:
ORDER-000 · No Designation

Entry Requirements: Standard physical assessment. No specialized training required.
Theological Position: Undetermined. Most subjects display basic reverence but lack systematic doctrinal framework.

Note: This designation serves as transitional status. Subjects typically undergo inclination assessment at Layers 3-5 before reassignment to specialized orders. Loss rates consistent with baseline parameters.

Recent Update: D-████ reported 'feeling the Engine's call' post-Layer VI. Moved to observation roster.

text_zh:
ORDER-444 · 熔变编制

入会条件: 心理韧性评估通过。能承受熔蜡接触及铭文组形变过程中的感知扭曲。
神学立场: 认为引擎本质为变化之流，固定形态违逆其意志。主张'顺应熔铸，拥抱重塑'。

备注: 该编制不在正式组织架构内，但§编号系统未设异端管理类别，故默认允许存在。个体常报告'听到铅字在歌唱'。使用熔蜡改造铭文组后，效果难以预测但通常强于预期。原因不明。第XI层以上存活个案罕见但存在。
text_en:
ORDER-444 · Molten Designation

Entry Requirements: Psychological resilience assessment required. Must withstand molten unguent contact and perceptual distortion during inscription metamorphosis.
Theological Position: Views Engine as essential flux; fixed forms violate its will. Advocates 'embrace the reforging, welcome reshaping.'

Note: This designation exists outside formal organizational structure, but §-numbering system lacks heresy management category, thus permitted by default. Subjects frequently report 'hearing glyphs singing.' Post-unguent inscription modifications unpredictable but typically exceed baseline performance. Mechanism unknown. Layer XI+ survival cases rare but documented.
